My dear [Mrs Coleridge](/person/348)
Alas, I have had so much Tyrol in the Monthly Packet as I am writing to tell [Mrs Prichard](/person/1893) I find no series of travels ever answers, people do not keep up their interest - though single papers succeed well.
I hope [Bishop Patteson’s life](/book/102) will be out in a few week’s time.

How soon do you return to Mapledurham for I should like my [‘Cousin Edward’](/person/332) as he insists on my calling him to have one of the first copies sent out

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Endorsed in pencil 1873.
